title: OpenAI is adding 250 jobs in Dublin as Ireland loses tech roles to AI elsewhere

content_html:
TL;DR

OpenAI is expanding its Dublin EU HQ with 250 new jobs and 88,000 sq ft of office space. Meta and TikTok recently cut Irish roles due to AI. Anthropic is also growing in Dublin.

OpenAI is expanding its European headquarters in Dublin with 250 new jobs and an 88,000-square-foot lease at the Tropical Fruit Warehouse in the city’s Docklands. The company currently employs around 100 people in Ireland and established its European presence there in 2023. The new roles span engineering, sales, user operations, HR, finance, privacy, and legal. OpenAI said the expansion is driven by “rapidly growing demand from users, customers and developers across the European region.”

The timing is pointed. Meta and TikTok both recently announced job cuts in Ireland, with AI cited as a factor. Ireland has been disproportionately affected by AI-related layoffs across the tech sector. The companies creating the AI tools that eliminate roles and the companies hiring to deploy those tools are operating in the same Dublin postcode. OpenAI won US clearance for a broad GPT-5.6 rollout after weeks of government testing, and the Dublin expansion positions the company to sell that capability across Europe with local staff who understand EU regulation.

Anthropic is also expanding its Dublin workforce. Ireland hosts the European headquarters of Meta, Apple, Alphabet, and most of the largest US tech companies, drawn by English-speaking talent, EU single-market access, and a historically favourable corporate tax regime. OpenAI and Anthropic joining the same city creates a concentration of frontier AI talent in Dublin that did not exist two years ago.

“Ireland’s talent base and strong research ecosystem puts us in a strong position to take advantage of the AI revolution,” said Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin. Anthropic filed confidentially for an IPO this year, and both companies are building European operations ahead of potential public listings that will require demonstrable international revenue. Dublin gives them a regulatory beachhead inside the EU’s AI Act jurisdiction and a hiring pool already trained by the same tech companies that are now cutting headcount. The 250 jobs OpenAI is adding may not offset the thousands Ireland has lost, but they signal where the replacement roles are coming from.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

OpenAI 正在扩建其都柏林欧盟总部，新增 250 个工作岗位和 88,000 平方英尺的办公空间。 由于人工智能，Meta 和 TikTok 最近削减了爱尔兰角色。 Anthropic也在都柏林蓬勃发展。

OpenAI 正在扩建其位于都柏林的欧洲总部，新增 250 个工作岗位，并在该市 Docklands 的热带水果仓库租用了 88,000 平方英尺的场地。 该公司目前在爱尔兰拥有约 100 名员工，并于 2023 年在那里建立了欧洲业务。 新角色涵盖工程、销售、用户运营、人力资源、财务、隐私和法律。 OpenAI 表示，此次扩张是由“整个欧洲地区用户、客户和开发者的需求快速增长”推动的。

时机已明确。 Meta 和 TikTok 最近都宣布在爱尔兰裁员，人工智能就是其中一个因素。 爱尔兰科技行业受到人工智能相关裁员的影响尤为严重。 创建消除角色的人工智能工具的公司以及雇用部署这些工具的公司都在同一个都柏林邮政编码中运营。 经过数周的政府测试后，OpenAI 获得了美国广泛部署 GPT-5.6 的许可，而都柏林的扩张使该公司能够通过了解欧盟法规的当地员工在整个欧洲销售该功能。

Anthropic 还扩大了都柏林的员工队伍。 爱尔兰是 Meta、Apple、Alphabet 和大多数美国最大科技公司的欧洲总部所在地，受到英语人才、欧盟单一市场准入以及历来优惠的企业税收制度的吸引。 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 加入同一座城市，使得都柏林成为了两年前还不存在的前沿人工智能人才集中地。

爱尔兰总理迈克尔·马丁表示：“爱尔兰的人才基础和强大的研究生态系统使我们在利用人工智能革命方面处于有利地位。” Anthropic 今年秘密申请首次公开募股，两家公司都在潜在的公开上市之前建立欧洲业务，这将需要可证明的国际收入。 都柏林为他们提供了欧盟人工智能法案管辖范围内的监管滩头阵地，以及已经由目前正在裁员的科技公司培训的招聘人才库。 OpenAI 增加的 250 个工作岗位可能无法抵消爱尔兰失去的数千个工作岗位，但它们表明了替代岗位的来源。
